text: はなしの　あうひとが　ぜーんぜん　いないわっ　この　ファンクラブ！

structure.jp: はなしの　あうひとが
structure.en: people I click with in conversation

structure.jp: ぜーんぜん　いないわっ
この　ファンクラブ！

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: はなしの　あうひと
patterns.explanation: A verb phrase put right before a noun describes that noun. Inside such a phrase の can stand in for が. はなしの あうひと = 'a person whose talk matches mine'.

patterns.name: 〜わ
patterns.explanation: わ at the end of a sentence is a feminine way of adding feeling to what you say. いないわっ = 'there just aren't any!'.
